patch.summary:
Choose ShipBob only if your buying job matches “Ecommerce fulfillment and logistics platform — affiliate partner in ecommerce.” rather than AliDrop's shape. Choose AliDrop only if your buying job matches “AliExpress/Temu/Alibaba dropshipping importer — Starter $39/mo, Pro $59/mo, Empire $99/mo,” rather than ShipBob's shape. Workflow advantage: ShipBob leans order-fulfillment; AliDrop leans dropshipping-sourcing. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Positioning: ShipBob is Ecommerce fulfillment and logistics platform — affiliate partner in ecommerce.; AliDrop is AliExpress/Temu/Alibaba dropshipping importer — Starter $39/mo, Pro $59/mo, Empire $99/mo, Unicorn $299/mo; $1 for 7-day trial on paid tiers.
- Company-size focus: ShipBob (small-business, mid-market) vs AliDrop (solo, micro, small-business).
- Workflow coverage skew: ShipBob-leaning order-fulfillment vs AliDrop-leaning dropshipping-sourcing.
- Researched limits: ShipBob — Requires an existing ecommerce storefront — not a cart or checkout product; AliDrop — Not a storefront — Shopify/Woo/etc. required.

Limitations — ShipBob: Requires an existing ecommerce storefront — not a cart or checkout product; Quote-based pricing with ~$275/mo minimum reported — opaque until sales conversation; AliDrop: Not a storefront — Shopify/Woo/etc. required; Shipping times and quality vary by marketplace supplier.

Poor-fit cases: ShipBob is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Requires an existing ecommerce storefront — not a cart or checkout product · AliDrop is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not a storefront — Shopify/Woo/etc. required · Avoid ShipBob if you actually need AliDrop's motion (AliExpress/Temu/Alibaba dropshipping importer — Starter $39/mo, Pro $59/mo, Empi)
